direct_chat_users_check.name: direct_chat_users_check
direct_chat_users_check.value: "chats"."type" = 'group' OR ("chats"."direct_user_a_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chats"."direct_user_b_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chats"."direct_user_a_id" <> "chats"."direct_user_b_id")

group_chat_users_check.name: group_chat_users_check
group_chat_users_check.value: "chats"."type" = 'direct' OR ("chats"."direct_user_a_id" IS NULL AND "chats"."direct_user_b_id" IS NULL)

users_identifier_present_check.name: users_identifier_present_check
users_identifier_present_check.value: "users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone_number" IS NOT NULL

message_attachments_dimensions_check.name: message_attachments_dimensions_check
message_attachments_dimensions_check.value: ("message_attachments"."width" IS NULL OR "message_attachments"."width" > 0) AND ("message_attachments"."height" IS NULL OR "message_attachments"."height" > 0)
